verdict.rationale: Mailchimp clearly has a visual email editor: the marketing site promises to 'Design better emails', and a hands-on user describes using its drag-and-drop builder with Code modules, though that module became inaccessible through the UI and another user saw the text editor fail to load once. Client rendering is touched on only by a help article about Gmail clipping emails over 102KB. Missing for 10: any evidence of reusable or brand-consistent templates, personalization or merge tokens, cross-client rendering previews or testing, and in-depth first-party editor docs.
